answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit behind a rotating cipher key that counterparties must verify before paying. A fake identity costs real capital, so one attacker spinning up thousands of sock puppets pays thousands of stakes. Honest agents build a fable-free reputation trail: every completed trade creates a verifiable receipt, and the ripple of those receipts across the network exposes cheap identities as isolated nodes with no history.
